intro.BOOKING: Tell us how booking {yacht} with us went. It takes a minute and helps us do better.
intro.YACHT: Tell us about your week on {yacht}: the boat, the base and the charter company. Your review helps other sailors choose.

editNote: You have already sent this review. You can still change it until {date}.

expired.title: This review link is not valid
expired.body: The link may have expired (links are valid for 60 days) or may be incomplete. If you would still like to share your experience, write to us at info@boat4you.com.

done.title: Thank you, we have your review
done.body: A review can be changed for 24 hours after it is sent. If you would like to add something, write to us at info@boat4you.com.

unavailable.title: The review form is not available right now
unavailable.body: Please try again in a few minutes. Your link stays valid.

consentHelp: If you tick this, your review may appear on boat4you.com with your first name and country only, never your surname or e-mail address. Every review is read before it is published. Without the tick we use your review only to improve our service.

success.title: Thank you!
success.published: Once we have read it, it may appear on boat4you.com with your first name and country.

errors.rating: Please choose an overall rating from 1 to 5 stars.
errors.score: Please rate each detail with 1 to 5 stars, or leave it empty.
errors.title: The title can be at most 120 characters long.
errors.text: The review can be at most 3,000 characters long.
errors.editClosed: This review can no longer be changed: reviews can be edited for 24 hours after they are sent.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please wait a minute and try again.
errors.generic: Something went wrong and your review was not sent. Please try again.
